race.description: Crjc Christmas Race Day 29 November Country Boosted Hcp (C2)
race.comment: WILD MONARCH (5) is the one to beat after turning a narrow Coffs Harbour second into a well-supported Class 1 win at Port Macquarie, where he overcame early trouble and a check before beating Trinity State by a long neck. The move to 1425m is new, but his five-start record is faultless for the multiples and he has already handled wet ground. PRINCE OF PROPHETS (1) has the right second-up profile after a luckless third at this track, with the check near the 900m and the hold-up on the home turn adding merit to a margin of just under a length. WHISKEY MISS (6) has to rebound from a plain Class 3 seventh at Lismore, but her previous BM66 fourth had genuine interference and Ben Looker back aboard is a positive. SPICY WINGS (3) was only beaten just over two lengths in a BM58 at Lismore and receives weight relief from that run, while his wide run in BM66 grade two back gives him enough substance to be a genuine danger.
